changeSet.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS trades CASCADE;

changeSet.author: student
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE trades ( id BIGSERIAL, trade_ref VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, instrument_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES instruments(id), counterparty_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES counterparties(id), asset_class VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, side VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL, quantity NUMERIC(18,4) NOT NULL, price NUMERIC(18,4) NOT NULL, trade_date DATE NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', deleted_at TIMESTAMP, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, modified_at TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id, trade_date), UNIQUE (trade_ref, trade_date) ) PARTITION BY RANGE (trade_date); CREATE INDEX idx_trades_trade_date ON trades (trade_date); CREATE INDEX idx_trades_status ON trades (status);

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS trades CASCADE;
